ns2:course.label: Medicine and Surgery I
ns2:course.description: Teaches the practice of medicine and surgery of anesthesiology, neurology, ophthalmology, reproduction, and neonatology. Surgery and Theriogenology laboratories occur throughout this course. No graduate credit. 10.5 professional hours. Prerequisite: VM 608 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, or consent of instructor.
